property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array and a callee that can both succeed and fail, the reference C always returns true (call completes) when the external calls succeed, whereas the mutant inverts the success check and will revert whenever an external call succeeds — so there exists inputs (a callee that succeeds and at least one _tos element) that make the mutant revert while the reference returns true.
change_summary: Replace the require(_s) after the call with require(!_s) so the function only continues when the external call fails, inverting the success check and affecting returns by causing different completion behavior.
